race.comment: Very moderate line-up with many non-winners. FLYING SHELBY (2) doesn't win out of turn but does boast good form for this. Carried almost 70kg in a highweight last time and freshened for this dropping back to the mile. Will be strong at the finish and gets chance to find form. ON THE MAP (7) was thereabouts last time and has winning claims this line-up. Trained on the course and pretty solid last three runs in similar company. SPLASH OF WHITE (6) may appreciate the extra trip now and is drawn for a soft run. SPELMAN (3) is better than last run when too far back and certainly worth another chance.
